description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for RFC API functions, including initialization, parameter retrieval and setting, error string mapping, and RFC enablement checks.

methods.name: init_rfcdefaults
methods.description: Initializes RFC defaults, tested for success and removal of default directory.

methods.name: getWriteCurlResponse
methods.description: Retrieves a function pointer for handling curl responses.

methods.name: writeToTr181storeFile
methods.description: Writes a parameter value to a specified TR-181 store file.

methods.name: getRFCParameter
methods.description: Retrieves RFC parameter values given a parameter name.

methods.name: write_on_file
methods.description: Creates or writes to a specified file, used for simulating HTTP server readiness.

methods.name: getRFCErrorString
methods.description: Maps RFC error codes to descriptive strings.

methods.name: isRFCEnabled
methods.description: Checks if RFC is enabled for a given instance.
